content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Sea temple on a rock, best when the tide rolls in and the light turns gold."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Sunset drinks, a pool, and the island's easiest good time after dark."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tiny plates of Balinese comfort food, with plenty of green things to share."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The terraces ripple like a green ocean, and the early light makes every step a postcard."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Holy springs where the water is said to wash more than just dust off your shoulders."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The cave mouth yawns with carvings, and inside it feels like the island is whispering."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Start with the ridge walk while the air is still soft and the views stretch wide."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander among long-tailed macaques and mossy temple gates in the forest."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Hunt for carved wood, batik and little treasures in the market stalls."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Step into the old royal courtyard and admire its carved stone doors."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A breezy pause for something cool and plant-based, never a full meal."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A long detour for lunch, but the vegetarian plates make it tempting."}]}
Sunset hello, jungle heart, temple mornings, and a sandy goodbye — every must-do tucked in.
